column1: # Findings that are known, understood and cannot be fixed here yet.
# A suppressed finding still renders, in its own section with its reason and
# review date, but does not hold the issue open: an issue that can never close
# stops being read. After the review date it counts again (and opens a new
# issue if none is open), so a suppression cannot become a silent pin.
